# Call Window EU Grants

> EU funding calls open now, from Horizon Europe to Erasmus+, searchable by deadline, programme and type of action. Free, updated daily from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.

Guides are researched from official sources, cite them, and are reviewed regularly.

## Data pages (rebuilt daily)
- [How to Apply for EU Funding: 6 Steps for First-Time Applicants](https://callwindowgrants.com/how-to-apply/): How to apply for EU funding calls: find a topic, read the conditions, get a free PIC, build a consortium and submit on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.
- [EU Funding Calls Closing Soon (Oct 2026): Deadlines in the Next 30 Days](https://callwindowgrants.com/closing-soon/): Open EU funding calls with a deadline in the next 30 days, soonest first. Free, updated daily from the EU Funding & Tenders Portal (2026-10-31).
- [EU Funding Calls Open Now (Oct 2026): All Calls Open for Submission](https://callwindowgrants.com/open/): 217 EU funding calls open for submission now, sorted by deadline, with programme, budget and type of action. Updated daily (2026-10-31).
- [Forthcoming EU Funding Calls (2026): Calls Opening Soon](https://callwindowgrants.com/forthcoming/): 255 forthcoming EU funding calls with planned opening dates and deadlines. Plan your proposal early. Updated daily (2026-10-31).
- [EU Funding Calls by Call Identifier](https://callwindowgrants.com/calls/): Open and upcoming EU funding topics grouped by call identifier (for example HORIZON-CL5-2027-06), with budgets and deadlines.
- [EU Funding Calls by Programme](https://callwindowgrants.com/programme/): Open and upcoming EU funding calls by programme: Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, Creative Europe, CERV, the European Defence Fund and more.
- [EU Funding Calls by Type of Action](https://callwindowgrants.com/action/): EU funding calls grouped by type of action: research and innovation actions, innovation actions, coordination and support actions, lump sum grants…
- [EU Funding Calls by Deadline Month](https://callwindowgrants.com/deadline/): Open and upcoming EU funding calls grouped by the month of their next deadline. Plan proposals months ahead.
- [EU Funding Calls by Theme](https://callwindowgrants.com/topic/): EU funding calls by theme: SMEs and startups, artificial intelligence, climate, health, digital, energy, cybersecurity and more.

## About the data
- Source: [EU Funding & Tenders Portal (European Commission)](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/)
- Licence: Reused under the Commission's reuse policy (Decision 2011/833/EU, CC BY 4.0); unofficial, not affiliated with the European Commission
- Updated once a day from the official public data. Unofficial; always confirm details on the official notice before applying or bidding.

## Guides
- [How to Apply for EU Funding: 7 Steps to Portal Submission](https://callwindowgrants.com/how-to-apply-for-eu-funding-7-steps-to-portal-submission/): How to apply for EU funding in 7 steps: find a call, check eligibility, get a PIC, build a consortium and submit on the Funding & Tenders Portal by 17:00.
- [Horizon Europe CSA Proposal Template: 7 Differences From RIA](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-europe-csa-proposal-template-7-differences-from-ria/): Horizon Europe CSA proposal template vs RIA: a section-by-section map of what changes in the 25-page CSA Part B, the 100% funding rate, TRL and impact.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Participant Register: 5 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-participant-register-5-steps/): How the EU Funding and Tenders Portal Participant Register works: PIC vs register, the 6-step wizard, LEAR appointment, validation documents and role updates.
- [Horizon Europe Proposal Template RIA: 40-Page Section Map](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-europe-proposal-template-ria-40-page-section-map/): Horizon Europe proposal template RIA (2026-27): the 40-page Part B limit, pages per section, RIA vs IA vs CSA differences and the Portal download steps.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Helpdesk: Ticket in 5 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-helpdesk-ticket-in-5-steps/): How to use the EU Funding and Tenders Portal helpdesk: open an IT ticket in 5 steps, what to include, response times, and when to call your NCP instead.
- [Horizon Europe Health Calls 2027: 17 Topics, Dates, Budgets](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-europe-health-calls-2027-17-topics-dates-budgets/): Horizon Europe health calls 2027: all 17 Cluster 1 topics in one table with budgets, 17 Feb and 16 Sep 2027 deadlines, page limits and steps to apply.
- [EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026: Deadlines & 7 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eic-pathfinder-2026-deadlines-3-challenges-7-steps/): EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026: Open call closed 12 May; Challenges close 28 October, €262M budget across 3 topics, page limits and 7 steps to apply.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal My Proposals: Status Table](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-my-proposals-status-table/): What each status in EU Funding and Tenders Portal My Proposals means, where to find your ESR and result letters, and what to do next, with menu paths.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Two Factor Authentication 2026](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-two-factor-authentication-2026/): EU Funding and Tenders Portal two factor authentication setup: EU Login app, passkey and security key in 5 steps, plus lost-phone recovery and fixes for 2026.
- [HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage: Dates & Page Limits](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-hlth-2027-02-tool-01-two-stage-dates-page-limits/): HORIZON-HLTH-2027-02-TOOL-01-two-stage guide: key 17 Feb and 16 Sep 2027 deadlines, 10- vs 40-page limits per stage, and portal submission steps for AI biomarker tool proposals.
- [Cascade Funding Open Calls: Portal Filters and 2026 Dates](https://callwindowgrants.com/cascade-funding-open-calls-portal-filters-and-2026-dates/): Find cascade funding open calls on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal: exact filter steps, the €60,000 FSTP cap, and key 2026 deadlines to track.
- [EIC Accelerator Deadlines 2026: Cut-Off Dates and Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eic-accelerator-deadlines-2026-cut-off-dates-and-steps/): EIC Accelerator deadlines 2026: cut-off dates, EIC Pre-Accelerator 2026 steps, and short-application windows—what each deadline requires before you apply.
- [EU Funding and Tenders Portal Registration: PIC in 6 Steps](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-and-tenders-portal-registration-pic-in-6-steps/): EU Funding and Tenders Portal registration in 6 wizard steps: EU Login, PIC, validation documents, LEAR appointment and fixes for VAT errors.
- [EIC Grants 2026: 7 Open EU Calls for SMEs & How to Qualify](https://callwindowgrants.com/eu-funding-for-smes-7-open-2026-calls-and-how-to-qualify/): EIC grants 2026: 7 open EU funding calls for SMEs, from EIC Accelerator to Digital Europe, matched by size and country, with eligibility steps to check.
- [Horizon Europe Proposal Template Part B: 2026 Scoring Map](https://callwindowgrants.com/horizon-europe-proposal-template-part-b-2026-scoring-map/): Horizon Europe proposal template Part B explained section by section, with the 40-page limit, what evaluators score, the 3.1 tables and common mistakes.
